notes: Added missing schema/contract and test coverage stories to complete feature lifecycle.

stories.title: Consent Data Schema & Storage Contract
stories.description: Define and implement the MongoDB schema and Pydantic models for consent records, including tier designation, timestamping, user/session linkage, and audit fields. Ensure strict contract enforcement for Tier 1 (de-identified) vs Tier 2 (identifiable) storage pathways.

stories.title: Consent Framework Test Suite
stories.description: Develop unit and integration tests validating two-tier consent behavior, including correct de-identification for Tier 1, persistence rules for Tier 2, rejection of invalid consent states, and enforcement across integrated services.
